reviewed_arguments: The actual inverse is obtained by uniform matrix geometric convergence on both signed normal tails, with the original leading matrix retained.
The finite residual polynomial cancels every coefficient below L. All base, tangential and normal derivatives preserve the exact T^(L-|alpha|) remainder, including negative tangential exponents.
Tangentially separated kernels retain a normal diagonal. A smooth frequency split, explicit integration-by-parts powers and all transition derivatives prove their two-tail estimates.
A faithful action on bounded-above formal series constructs the ordered algebra. Negative powers and associativity are proved without assuming an analytic operator expansion.
Both complete inverse recursions keep their input and output spaces, generalized binomial coefficients, tangential operator products and every normal-parameter derivative.
The finite geometric correction preserves two distinct error sides; no equality of those errors is claimed.
The variable coefficient example distinguishes the pointwise inverse from the full operator coefficients and checks the exact first correction sign.
The diagram threshold is explicitly illustrative. Actual composition closure, half-space estimates and traces remain subsequent analytic steps.
